The '''Viis Empire''' was a [[Empire (disambiguation)|realm]] located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Its [[Capital/Legends|capital]] was the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Viis]]. It kept the [[Aaroun]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] and bred them as servants and [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]]. The Vlis Empire was decimated by the [[Changeling/Legends|shape shifting]], malevolent entity known as the [[Mnggal-Mnggal]] and collapsed as a result.

The Viis and their clothing resembled a [[Unidentified frilled reptiloid species|reptilian species]] of which a [[Unidentified New Republic reptilian diplomat|New Republic diplomat]] belonged to.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Viis Empire first appeared in the book series [[W:c:lucasfilm:Alien Chronicles|''Alien Chronicles'']] made by [[Lucasfilm]]. Its inclusion in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' [[canon]]izes its existence in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe.
